breakdown.description: The centroid point load is replaced by a uniform traction over the hypotenuse
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to regularize the point load by distributing it as a uniform traction over the hypotenuse. The ground truth corrects this by stating the load should be a concentrated load represented by a `PointSource`. The generated specification correctly states, 'A vertical point load of -5 kN will be applied at the point (0.5, 0.25) using `PointSource`,' which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
